# `sim/ai/AIBehaviorTree.js`

> **Source:** `engine/sim/ai/AIBehaviorTree.js`

AIBehaviorTree.js ⚠️ MULTIPLAYER: Uses deterministic RNG from AIRandom.js Uses AISchema.js for consistent node type definitions.

## Functions

### `createSelector(name, children = [])`

Create a Selector node (OR logic) Runs children left-to-right, succeeds if ANY child succeeds

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `children` *(Array<Object>)* — Child nodes

**Returns:** Selector node

### `createSequence(name, children = [])`

Create a Sequence node (AND logic) Runs children left-to-right, fails if ANY child fails

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `children` *(Array<Object>)* — Child nodes

**Returns:** Sequence node

### `createParallel(name, children = [], successThreshold = -1, failureThreshold = 1)`

Create a Parallel node Runs all children simultaneously

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `children` *(Array<Object>)* — Child nodes
- `successThreshold` *(number)* — Number of successes needed (default: all)
- `failureThreshold` *(number)* — Number of failures to fail (default: 1)

**Returns:** Parallel node

### `createRandomSelector(name, children = [])`

Create a Random Selector (picks random child)

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `children` *(Array<Object>)* — Child nodes

**Returns:** Random selector node

### `createInverter(name, child)`

Create an Inverter decorator Inverts child result: SUCCESS ↔ FAILURE

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `child` *(Object)* — Child node

**Returns:** Inverter node

### `createRepeater(name, child, times = -1)`

Create a Repeater decorator Repeats child N times or until failure

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `child` *(Object)* — Child node
- `times` *(number)* — Times to repeat (-1 for infinite)

**Returns:** Repeater node

### `createUntilFail(name, child)`

Create an UntilFail decorator Repeats child until it fails

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `child` *(Object)* — Child node

**Returns:** UntilFail node

### `createUntilSuccess(name, child)`

Create an UntilSuccess decorator Repeats child until it succeeds

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `child` *(Object)* — Child node

**Returns:** UntilSuccess node

### `createSucceeder(name, child)`

Create a Succeeder decorator Always returns SUCCESS

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `child` *(Object)* — Child node

**Returns:** Succeeder node

### `createFailer(name, child)`

Create a Failer decorator Always returns FAILURE

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `child` *(Object)* — Child node

**Returns:** Failer node

### `createCooldown(name, child, cooldownMs)`

Create a Cooldown decorator Prevents child from running until cooldown expires

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `child` *(Object)* — Child node
- `cooldownMs` *(number)* — Cooldown in milliseconds

**Returns:** Cooldown node

### `createConditionGuard(name, child, condition)`

Create a Condition Guard decorator Only runs child if condition is met

**Parameters:**

- `name` *(string)* — Node name
- `child` *(Object)* — Child node
- `condition` *(Function)* — Condition function (blackboard) => boolean

**Returns:** Condition guard node

## Notes & Examples

### Physics Engine Integration

The physics system provides rigid body dynamics, collision detection, and raycasting. Bodies have shapes (box, sphere, mesh), mass properties, and constraints. The GPU physics engine accelerates broad-phase collision detection and particle systems.

**Example: Creating physics bodies**
```js
import { PhysicsWorld } from 'engine/physics/PhysicsWorld.js';
import { RigidBody } from 'engine/physics/RigidBody.js';
import { BoxShape, SphereShape } from 'engine/physics/Shapes.js';

const world = new PhysicsWorld({ gravity: [0, -9.8, 0] });

// Static ground
const ground = new RigidBody({
  type: 'static',
  shape: new BoxShape(10, 1, 10),
  position: [0, -0.5, 0]
});
world.addBody(ground);

// Dynamic box
const box = new RigidBody({
  type: 'dynamic',
  mass: 1,
  shape: new BoxShape(1, 1, 1),
  position: [0, 5, 0],
  restitution: 0.5  // Bounciness
});
world.addBody(box);
```

**Advanced: Collision detection and raycasting**
```js
// Raycast to find what the player is looking at
const hit = world.raycast(camera.position, camera.forward, 100);
if (hit) {
  console.log('Hit entity:', hit.body.entityId);
  console.log('Hit point:', hit.point);
  console.log('Hit normal:', hit.normal);
  
  // Apply impulse at hit point
  hit.body.applyImpulse([0, 10, 0], hit.point);
}

// Shapecast (swept sphere) for character movement
const sweep = world.shapecast(
  player.position,           // Start
  desiredPosition,           // End
  new SphereShape(0.5),    // Player capsule radius
  { ignore: player.body }  // Don't collide with self
);
if (sweep.hit) {
  // Slide along wall
  player.position = sweep.position;
}
```

**Advanced: Constraints and joints**
```js
import { HingeConstraint, FixedConstraint } from 'engine/physics/Constraints.js';

// Door hinge
const doorHinge = new HingeConstraint({
  bodyA: doorFrame,
  bodyB: door,
  pivot: [0, 1, 0],      // Hinge location
  axis: [0, 1, 0],       // Hinge axis (Y up)
  limits: [-90, 90]      // Open angle range in degrees
});
world.addConstraint(doorHinge);

// Ragdoll joint (ball-and-socket)
const shoulder = new FixedConstraint({
  bodyA: torso,
  bodyB: arm,
  pivotA: [0.5, 1.5, 0],  // Shoulder position on torso
  pivotB: [0, 0, 0]       // Shoulder position on arm
});
world.addConstraint(shoulder);
```

**Advanced: Continuous collision detection (CCD)**
```js
// Fast-moving objects need CCD to not tunnel through walls
const projectile = new RigidBody({
  type: 'dynamic',
  shape: new SphereShape(0.1),
  mass: 0.1,
  ccd: { enabled: true, sweptSphereRadius: 0.1 },
  linearDamping: 0  // No air resistance for bullets
});
projectile.velocity = [0, 0, 100];  // Very fast
world.addBody(projectile);
```

**Gotchas:**
- **Units**: Physics uses meters, kilograms, seconds. A 1-unit cube is 1 meter.
- **Time step**: Fixed time step (1/60) gives stable simulation; variable dt causes explosions.
- **Collision layers**: Use collision masks to filter what collides (player vs enemy, bullet vs world).
- **Sleeping**: At-rest bodies sleep to save CPU — wake them before applying forces.
